spec.name: himem_hymemory_mragent_patterns
spec.purpose: Episode/note two-layer memory index with deterministic segmentation and conflict-aware update, L0-L7 layered chat memory with intention expiry, scene-routed fact/experience memory with coding diff-chain coordinates, and graph-reconstruction rewrite note, all restated in our own words

summary: Patterns from jojopdq/HiMem (Apache-2.0) and Tencent-Hunyuan/Hy-Memory (Apache-2.0), plus ideas only from Ji-shuo/MRAgent (no LICENSE file), owoakuma/LycheeMemory (no LICENSE file), and refrefhq/refref (AGPL-3.0): an episode/note two-layer memory index where episodes are fine-grained temporally grounded segments and notes are stable facts/preferences/profiles, with deterministic topic-shift-or-salience segmentation and conflict-aware update keeping superseded facts traceable; an L0-L7 layered chat memory (raw append-only, atomic versioned facts, session summaries, schema/intention layers) with intention expiry and demotion to ordinary facts; a scene router sending chat/working/coding work into different pipelines, with working/coding two-layer fact+experience records, a value threshold on experiences, bidirectional links, and a coding diff-chain recording file/function/branch coordinates instead of pasted code; and a graph-reconstruction rewrite note (self-contained sentences, pronoun resolution, absolute dates, topic tags) with a deterministic keyword/topic/personal/temporal/context retrieval vocabulary. All restated in our own words, stdlib-only, no provider/network/API-key/server/MCP/GPU/model-weight/payment code.
